Chemistry Calculations — FHIR Questionnaire Template

Electrolytes, calcium, albumin, glucose and insulin with anion gap, albumin-corrected calcium and HOMA-IR.

Scoring

Calculated values only; each result stays empty until all of its inputs are answered.

Questions

  1. Sodium (mmol/L)
  2. Chloride (mmol/L)
  3. Bicarbonate (mmol/L)
  4. Total calcium (mg/dL)
  5. Albumin (g/dL)
  6. Fasting glucose (mg/dL)
  7. Fasting insulin (µU/mL)

Calculated results

  • Anion gap (mmol/L)
  • Albumin-corrected calcium (mg/dL)
  • HOMA-IR

Source and license

Source: Standard potassium-free form: Na − (Cl + HCO₃); Payne et al. 1973, BMJ 4:643; Matthews et al. 1985, Diabetologia 28:412. Codes: LOINC.

License: Original wording written for this builder; covered by the project license (non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use needs written permission). Formulas are published methods; see the source. (link)

Provided to save authoring effort, not as medical advice — confirm the scale and its cut-offs for your use case.

Use it

  1. Download the FHIR Questionnaire JSON, or
  2. open the Builder, choose + Add → From template…, search for “Chemistry Calculations” and insert it. It arrives as one titled group with its calculations wired, and you can keep editing it.
